goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann soziale Ungleichheit, Einkommens- und Bildungsverteilung beschreiben und Ursachen diskutieren.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Different resources, study conditions and travel routes can illustrate unequal educational opportunity. But this pair assigns all favorable conditions to a lighter-skinned boy and all unfavorable conditions to a darker-skinned girl. That simultaneously couples disadvantage to skin tone and gender without such a claim in the actual learning goal; the stated author prompt explicitly sought to avoid this demographic correlation.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the quiet-versus-noisy home, money/books and unequal routes remain clear, as does the demographic pairing. The issue does not disappear when reduced.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the paired resource contrasts and skin-tone/gender coupling are explicit. Both learners retain equal effort and neither is shown inevitably failing.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The learners face the same school destination, and study books have no inverted legible text. The blocker concerns unsupported demographic allocation, not physical perspective.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

blockingFindings.location: Paired learners and paired home/resource scenes
blockingFindings.finding: Every advantageous condition is assigned to the lighter-skinned boy, every disadvantage to the darker-skinned girl, creating an unsupported demographic coupling in the hypothetical comparison.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Show the same learner in both clearly hypothetical resource situations, or demographically parallel learners with explicit A/B framing. Retain the resource/route contrast and equal dignity, without linking the contrast to skin tone or gender. Preserve original and inspect the corrected PNG independently.
